question: Kill timekeeper-a while holding timekeeper. Seconds until assume_role succeeds for B?
summary: Median 24.5 s over 5 trials (min 23.9, max 25.6). The holder renewed every 2 s; the server's lease TTL is 6 s (room_role_store.LEASE_TTL), so the floor is about 6 s minus the time since the last renewal. The standby polled every 250 ms.
environment: switch-core started from the cloned repository with a local Postgres, no Docker, in a Claude Code cloud session. Not the Codespace server.
